name: mrt-api-doctor
description: Codex plugin for reviewing MyRealTrip marketing-partner Open API/MCP integration code against public developer-doc pitfalls. Not a travel recommender.

interface.shortDescription: Reviews MyRealTrip Open API/MCP integration code against public-doc pitfalls.
interface.longDescription: A developer tool for linting MyRealTrip marketing-partner Open API/MCP integration code against pitfalls documented in the public developer center: per-category pagination differences, airport-vs-city code parameters, mylink URL limits, pageSize and lookback limits, 429 handling, and Bearer auth mistakes. It verifies rule quotes from public docs and runs demos/tests without real API keys or private data.
capabilities: Lint integration code against public developer-doc pitfalls
Explain each finding with the exact public-doc quote
Verify rule quotes against the current public docs bundle
Probe the public MyRealTrip MCP endpoint health without an API key
defaultPrompt: 마이리얼트립 API 연동 코드 점검 데모 보여줘
